title: Asthma exacerbation; thin summary: one-line course, no disposition, follow-up with no clinician, no PCP, not sent, no planning evaluation

rationale.hospital_course: The course section exists but is four words long; it does not say what was treated, how, or the outcome beyond 'Improved'.
rationale.disposition: The disposition hint (Home) comes from the registration system; no document states where the patient was discharged to.
rationale.followup: A test and a timeframe are given, but no clinician or clinic the patient should see.
rationale.pcp_named: No primary care provider or follow-up clinician is named anywhere.
rationale.info_transmitted: There is no evidence the summary was sent to any outpatient provider.
rationale.dp_evaluation: No discharge planning evaluation of post-hospital needs is documented; there is no case management note.
rationale.dp_discussed: The discharge plan was reviewed with the patient and she verbalized understanding.
rationale.pac_list: Not referred to home health, SNF, IRF or LTCH, so the three post-acute rules do not apply.
rationale.meds_consistent: No nursing discharge instructions were provided, so there is nothing to compare.
